preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner or have authorized privileges
Contract must hold BNB balance or token reserves

exploit_hint: As the contract owner or authorized address, call the cSb() function with a high percentage parameter (e.g., 100) to drain all BNB from the contract to the tfU (take fee utility) address, which is initially set to the deployer. Alternatively, use approvals() to distribute BNB to multiple fee addresses (krhF, mdhS, wthT, extR) which are also initially controlled by the deployer. The attacker can first ensure they control these recipient addresses via setrecadd() or similar functions.
